sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street; welfare check there and at the 77 Convenience Store, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep.
Full sweep complete, no issues to report; standing by for security presence and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred.
Welfare check at Nandos and Queens Court, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the Auckland Library check-in, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at the Lorne Street check-in; welfare check at the Red Radisson, all clear, no issues reported.
Arrived at the corner of High Street and Victoria Street East; welfare check on all stores on Lorne Street complete, no issues to report. Check-in on the Red Radisson garage, nothing to report.
Arrived at Freyberg Square / Chancery Square; welfare check on stores along High Street complete, no issues. Food stalls are being set up at Freyberg Square; standing by for security presence.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred.
Arrived at Fort Street / Jean Batten Place; commencing welfare checks on stores and a full sweep down to Gore Street.

Full sweep of Fort Street, the Wilson Carpark and Commerce Street complete; welfare checks on stores all clear, nothing reported. Maintaining presence on Fort Street for the public, surrounding businesses and any nearby response calls.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.

Arrived at TK Square; welfare check at Kowhai Cafe, McDonald's Britomart, the Commercial Bay Shopping Centre and Adidas, all clear, nothing to report. Standing by ensuring presence is known to the public and surrounding businesses.
No issues occurred within the area; all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at Albert Street; commencing welfare checks on stores along Albert Street.
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street and Victoria Street West; welfare checks along Albert Street complete, all clear, nothing to report.
Arrived at the top of Victoria Street West; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
No issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at Elliott Street; welfare check on stores on Wellesley Street West and Te Waihorotiu train station, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check on stores on Elliott Street complete, no issues to report.
Arrived on Queen Street outside Footlocker; maintaining security presence for any response calls and on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham Street; welfare check on stores along Queen Street between Victoria Street and Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues reported. Standing by maintaining presence.
Leaving standby area; no issues or problematic vagrants occurred within the area.
Arrived at TK Square; standing by for any problematic issues or vagrants that may occur within the area.
Leaving standby area; no issues occurred within the area.
Arrived at Gore Street; welfare check on stores within the area, all clear, nothing to report. Maintaining presence on Fort Street.
Arrived at lower Queen Street; patrolling through Queen Street.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street.
Arrived outside Footlocker; standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues.
Leaving standby area; commencing patrols up to Aotea Square while also looking for the male person of interest from the Red Radisson.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a sweep.
Full sweep complete, no issues; no visual of the male person of interest from the Red Radisson.
Heading back to HQ; the Ops Phone is low on battery and needs charging.
Arrived at HQ; charging the Ops Phone while remaining vigilant for any response calls. (Percentage shown on the kitchen camera.)
Response call from Countdown Victoria Street West regarding a male causing a disturbance towards their customers and begging outside the store.

Arrived at the response call; the store's security guard pointed out the male vagrant. Approached him and advised he had to move along at the request of store staff; he complied and moved along. Standing by in case he returns.
Heading back to HQ for handover.
Morning Shift concluded; handover to the Afternoon Shift. Auror reports have been processed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Ops Phone charged at HQ due to low percentage before commencing patrols.
Response call from Victoria Street Countdown regarding a male vagrant outside the premises.

Arrived at the response location; briefed by the on-site guard before approaching the vagrant taking shelter outside the premises, who had been shouting at customers walking in. Approached him and kindly asked him to leave the site; standing by until the vagrant and his belongings are gone.
Vagrant and belongings have been moved along; continuing patrols.
Received a call from management to return to Headquarters to swipe him into the office; en route.
Arrived at Headquarters; standing by for management assistance.
Swiped management up; all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street to commence welfare checks.
Welfare check on all businesses from Mecca and Farmers through to Glassons and 2degrees, all clear; commencing a sweep up Durham Street.
Received a call from management (Hasi) to meet at Headquarters to return a belonging to the office; en route.
Arrived; placed the stolen item in the office for safekeeping.
Standing by outside the office maintaining presence.
Moved along a group of vagrants taking shelter outside Ippondo; standing by until the group has cleared out.
Welfare check at Ippondo; the vagrants have been moved along. Resuming patrols.
Welfare check, all clear. Patrolling to Aotea Square:
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing a full sweep and maintaining presence due to heavy foot traffic in the area.
Still at Aotea Square conducting the sweep (16:10 – 16:25).

Full sweep of Aotea Square conducted. Received a response call from Pop Mart on Queen Street regarding a male vagrant taking shelter outside the premises, consuming illegal substances and disturbing customers' peace; en route.
Arrived at the response location; the male vagrant was outside the store. Kindly asked him to move along; standing by until the vagrant leaves the site.
Welfare check at Pop Mart, all clear; patrolling down Queen Street to Commercial Bay.
Full sweep of Queen Street with welfare checks on all businesses in the area; arrived at Britomart, commencing a sweep.
Full sweep conducted at Britomart; welfare check on all businesses in the area. Patrolling down Customs Street West.
Standing down patrols — received a response call from the SkyCity 77 Convenience Store regarding a male vagrant disturbing customers' peace and shouting outside; en route.
Arrived at the response location; the vagrant was still outside. Confronted him and kindly asked him to leave the premises politely; standing by until the vagrant and his belongings are gone.
Vagrant and belongings off site; welfare check on Victoria Street West and the 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Federal Street.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear, no issues; arriving at Federal Square.
Welfare check at the Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Federal Square; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square; welfare check at Gastro Square, the cathedral, Liston House and Hotel Indigo, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters to commence floor checks.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed; short toilet break (18:24 – 18:48).
Break completed. Received a response call from Queen Street McDonald's regarding a group of vagrants taking shelter in front of the premises; en route.
Arrived at the response location; the group of vagrants was still taking shelter. Approached and kindly asked them to vacate the premises; standing by until the group leaves the area.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues; patrolling Mid City to Elliott Street.
Mid City all clear, no issues to report; patrolling Elliott Street.
Arrived at Elliott Stables; standing by maintaining presence (19:04 – 19:45).
Full sweep of Elliott Street, the Elliott carpark, Elliott Stables and the on-site guard, all clear, no issues. Heading to Headquarters to charge the Ops Phone and let in a fellow guard.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone due to low percentage (19:47 – 20:11).
Received a response call from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a group of vagrants taking shelter outside the premises again; en route.
Arrived at the response location; it was the same group of vagrants encountered earlier. Kindly asked them to move along; standing by until all belongings are removed from the premises.
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrols through the walkway to Lorne Street.
Welfare check at the Timezone Centre, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at the Red Radisson and the broken door; standing by maintaining presence.
Received a call from a fellow guard to let them in at Level 1.
Arrived at Headquarters; let in the standby guard and gave an introduction.
Received a call from another fellow guard to let them in.
Let in the second standby guard; continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Welfare check on Queen Street, all clear; patrolling Shortland Street.
Full sweep of Shortland Street; welfare check at Shortland Mart, Taco Bell and Haven Mart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling Fort Lane.
Welfare check, all clear, no issues. Heading back to Headquarters to commence a 30-minute break:
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 30-minute break while responding to any calls that occur.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Having a debrief before commencing patrols.
Welfare check at Celines and the Elliott carpark, all clear; arrived at Bar 101, standing by maintaining presence.
Welfare check at Bar 101, all clear; patrolling up Victoria Street.
Welfare check on Victoria Street West and the Skymart Convenience Store; patrolling Albert Street.
Welfare check at the Ace Karaoke Bar, all clear; continuing patrols down Albert Street.
Standing by at Ace Live House maintaining presence.
Patrolling down Queen Street to Headquarters to retrieve an item.
Received a response call from the 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street regarding a male vagrant shouting and disturbing customers' peace; en route.
Arrived at the response location; the vagrant was still outside the premises. Kindly asked him to move along; standing by until the vagrant and all belongings are off site.
Welfare check at the 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues; continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Victoria Street all clear; patrolling down Queen Street.
Queen Street all clear; patrolling Shortland Street.
Welfare check on Shortland Street and at Shortland Mart, all clear; patrolling Fort Lane.
Welfare check at Evans Kebabs, The Right Track, Jo & Joes, Mr Murdochs, The White Lady and the Fort Wilson Carpark, all clear; arriving at Sapphire nightclub.
Arrived at Sapphire nightclub; standing by maintaining presence in the area.
Full sweep of Fort Lane; welfare check at Sapphire nightclub; patrolling to Britomart.
Welfare check with McDonald's Britomart staff and the on-site guard, all clear, no issues; patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check at Kemuri and Reign & Pour as well as their guards, all clear, no issues; standing by maintaining presence.
Heading back to the office to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone while responding to any calls that occur.
Received a response call from the QF Tav bar regarding a group of adults fighting outside the premises; en route.
Arrived at the location; the group of adults was still fighting outside. Quickly intercepted and stopped the fight from further escalation; standing by until the crowd cleared out.

As the crowd was about to clear, two cars loaded with male adults pulled over. One individual involved in the fight pointed out another party, who ran down Wyndham Street, and a massive brawl broke out. The team repeatedly got in the middle, but the number of individuals was too great; the brawl was stopped to the best of the team's abilities.
The fight has been stopped; standing by in case a second brawl occurs.
Received a response call from Snickel Lane regarding an unresponsive male individual inside the premises; en route.

Arrived at the location; the male was unresponsive and unable to cooperate. The team moved him out of the premises as the site was closing; standing by with the male to make sure he gets safely to his destination.
Still standing by until the individual leaves safely.
Standing down — the individual is safe. Heading back to the office to charge the Ops Phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at Headquarters; charging the Ops Phone while responding to any calls that occur.
Standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone (02:55 – 04:17).
Welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street, all clear; patrolling to Darby Street.
Welfare check on Darby Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at the Elliott carpark and Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check at the Victoria Street 77 Convenience Store and the Skymart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Federal Street, all clear; arrived at Federal Square, commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Federal Square; patrolling down Swanson Street West.
Welfare check on Swanson Street West, all clear; patrolling down Albert Street.
Welfare check at Albert Mart, all clear, no issues.
Albert Street all clear, no issues to report.
The whole of Lower Albert Street all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Britomart; commencing a sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart, all clear, no issues; making our way back to Headquarters to commence a 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing a 30-minute break.
Night Shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: SENSITIVE: 01:44–02:00 QF Tav / Wyndham Street — street fight escalated into a large brawl after two carloads of male adults arrived; the team physically intervened while heavily outnumbered and stopped it 'to the best of our abilities'. No injuries recorded and no Police attendance logged.

NOTE: 14:04 call logged as from 'Countdown Victoria Street West' but the follow-up references 'New World staff' — store identity inconsistent in the raw log; rendered as Countdown Victoria Street West.
NOTE: raw Morning Shift closing line read 'handover to night shift' at 14:30 — corrected to Afternoon Shift.
